gen-dafont-hammerhead-gf-stint-ultra-exp: Industrial and plain, Hammerhead draws unmodulated outlines with an e that never squeezes shut. Stint Ultra Expanded lets its authoritative letters float apart, so paragraphs move slowly and openly.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-pridi: Pridi brings small letters that stand proud, almost capital-sized, with generous room between curve ends and stems, under the heavy Impact Label. Each Impact Label letter stands alone, bead-like and commanding.
gen-dafont-impact-label-inter: Impact Label stands heavy, each letter alone like a bead on a rod, its c pincers pointing apart. Inter takes over below with smooth tube-like lines, strokes that never swell or thin.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-glegoo: Glegoo's big counters and wide, unclosed curves make it feel refined, tall in the lowercase. Yet Jelly Crazies, wobbly with nearly sealed bowls, slows any run of text to a leisurely walk.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-scope-one: Jelly Crazies wobbles playfully, its bowls nearly sealed shut. Scope One spills its counters into the surrounding space, beside stubby ascenders and a big x-height, so closed meets open.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-inter: Jelly Crazies wobbles, its bowls nearly sealed shut. Inter opens everything back up with tube-smooth lines and big counters in a tall lowercase, so extended reading glides along without a stumble.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-fauna-one: Joystix goes arcade-bold, widely tracked and loud. Fauna One settles into a dignified, literary rhythm, its tall middle band and shallow ascenders easy on the eye over whole paragraphs.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noticia-text: Arcade-bold Joystix stamps out widely tracked letters with a soft, hand-inked modulation. And Noticia Text, with big visible entrances into curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the height, gives paragraphs a literary, dignified feel.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-slabo-13px: Dignified Slabo 13px keeps clear openings in its rounded letters, while Joystix, arcade-bold, adds soft accents of heavier strokes. Loud up top, bookish and hushed below, they share the page.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-manrope: Friendly Lemon Milk spreads loose, wide tracking over rounded letters that stay open and inviting. Manrope matches that welcome with a bright gap at every curve's mouth and a minimal step from capital to lowercase.
